title: Molecular Insights into the Binding of Linear Polyethylenimines and Single-Stranded DNA Using Raman Spectroscopy: A Quantitative Approach.
authors: Mustafa, Rusul; Fitian, Maria; Hamilton, Nicholas B; Li, Jianing; Silva, W Ruchira; Punihaole, David
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用拉曼光谱结合分子动力学研究PEI与ssDNA的结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但对象为聚合物而非蛋白质，且方法以光谱为主、MD为辅，与TF-DNA核心课题关联较弱。
abstract: Establishing how polymeric vectors such as polyethylenimine (PEI) bind and package their nucleic acid cargo is vital toward developing more efficacious and cost-effective gene therapies. To develop a molecular-level picture of DNA binding, we examined how the Raman spectra of PEIs report on their local chemical environment. We find that the intense Raman bands located in the 1400-1500 cm(-1) region derive from vibrations with significant CH(2) scissoring and NH bending character. The Raman bands that derive from these vibrations show profound intensity changes that depend on both the local dielectric environment and hydrogen bonding interactions with the secondary amine groups on the polymer. We use these bands as spectroscopic markers to assess the binding between low molecular weight PEIs and single-stranded DNA (ssDNA). Analysis of the Raman spectra suggest that PEI primarily binds via electrostatic interactions to the phosphate backbone, which induces the condensation of the ssDNA. We additionally confirm this finding by conducting molecular dynamics simulations. We expect that the spectral correlations determined here will enable future studies to investigate important gene delivery activities, including how PEI interacts with cellular membranes to facilitate cargo internalization into cells.
abstract_zh: 建立聚合物载体（如聚乙烯亚胺 (polyethylenimine, PEI)）如何结合并包装其核酸货物的机制，对于开发更有效且成本更低的基因疗法至关重要。为了构建DNA结合的分子层面图像，我们研究了PEI的拉曼光谱如何反映其局部化学环境。我们发现，位于1400-1500 cm(-1)区域的强拉曼谱带源自具有显著CH(2)剪式振动和NH弯曲特征的振动。源自这些振动的拉曼谱带显示出强烈的强度变化，这些变化取决于局部介电环境以及与聚合物上仲胺基团的氢键相互作用。我们利用这些谱带作为光谱标记，来评估低分子量PEI与单链DNA (single-stranded DNA, ssDNA) 之间的结合。拉曼光谱分析表明，PEI主要通过静电相互作用与磷酸骨架结合，这诱导了ssDNA的凝聚。我们还通过进行分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟进一步确认了这一发现。我们预期，此处确定的谱学相关性将使未来研究能够探索重要的基因递送活动，包括PEI如何与细胞膜相互作用以促进货物内化进入细胞。
